learned_preprocessing: NONE is shipped. Every learned step below must be fitted on split == 'train' only and then applied unchanged to validation, test and forward_holdout

applies_to: ppg*/gf*/ga*/rest only if NaN appears in new data
steps.rule: train-split median; add an indicator; or use a NaN-tolerant model
mean and std from train split only (linear models, k-NN, neural nets)
vocabulary from train split only, unknown -> 'other'; no target encoding
fitted on train (weights) and validation (calibration); never on test or forward holdout

forbidden: fitting any transformer on the full dataset
using forward_holdout labels or metrics for any decision before the single final evaluation
